title: Entitled Karen Gets a Much-Needed Reality Check
description:
On February 24th, 2024. A traffic stop was conducted after officers noticed a woman who was speeding and swerving all over the road. After they conducted sobriety tests on her and indeed found her drunk, they decided they wouldn't arrest her but would have to find a ride home, but her insane entitlement wouldn't let her leave without cuffs.
